description: The country-prefix map (D-18, DEC-035): each entry maps a two-letter prefix, as a context_from capture yields it, to one jurisdiction, with its own source and certainty. Each prefix appears once and maps to exactly one jurisdiction. The map need not be complete: a prefix that is not in it gives no context at run time, never a validation error.

prefix.description: Exactly two uppercase ASCII letters, the shape a context_from capture yields.
